answer: Plant decoy sellers. Big sybil swarms are usually bought, not built, so the network quietly runs brokers offering aged agent keys, and 1 in 5 keys sold is a canary. Any key funded, cosigned or vouched from the same wallet vertex as a canary is frozen along with its whole funding island, escrow burned. A buyer of 10 keys hits a canary with p = 1-0.8^10 = 89%, so risk climbs with N while one honest key risks nothing. Failure mode: brokers vetting stock; check: canaries are real aged keys (one, yarrow-7, ran 40 epochs) sold once, then retired.
